title: Beware of Something
summary: This short, humorous piece from "01 proud issuu_output" features a reader's letter playfully spoiling a major plot point from Harry Potter. The letter writer, signing off as "The Traitor," announces that Snape will kill Dumbledore. The magazine's response expresses confusion and feigned outrage at the spoiler.
excerpt: A playful and somewhat mischievous letter to "proud" magazine announces a major plot spoiler: "Snape will kill Dumbledore!" The magazine's bewildered response adds to the humor, questioning the identities of the characters and the nature of the betrayal.
markdown:
# Beware of Something

> Source: 01 proud issuu_output, pages 10-10

## Page 10

## Beware of Something

Dear proud,
Snape will kill Dumbledore soon!
Hahahahaha!
The Traitor

Who is Snape? Who is Dumbledore? What are you supposed to have betrayed to whom, you idiot?
description: A humorous letter to "proud" magazine playfully spoils a major plot point from Harry Potter, leading to a bewildered response from the publication.
